note: buildGraph cases: args = [rows as [{id, label, links: {path: count}, props: {propertyId: value}}], options {showOrphans, linkEdges, sharedProps, maxGroup, focus, depth}]; expected = nodes as ids in order, edges as [source, target, kind, weight, mutual] for links and [source, target, kind, weight, prop, values] for shared values, and hidden {orphans, outside} when present. Cases with a "function" field call that export of the same module (sizeScale, colorScale, parseNumber) with args and compare the whole result. linkCounts counts resolved reference targets and filters property cache keys. Heading mode (1.5.0): options {headings: 'linked' | 'all', chain, maxLevel}; rows carry headings [{heading, level, line}] and refs [{line, target, heading (index), block {id, line}, missing, relation}]. Expected adds parents (node index of the parent of each heading or block node, null for notes) and missing; part edges are [source, target, 'part', weight]. Function cases also cover headingLinkText, sectionAt, headingParents and headingKeys.
